A '''steel spear''' is a [[spear]] of the [[Steel equipment|steel]] tier, made by smithing an [[iron spear]] with [[steel alloy]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template. Enchantments on the iron item carry over; where both items have the same enchantment, the higher level is kept.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Hp|4}} damage at an attack speed of 0.9, adds 1 attack knockback, and has 3000 durability.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[iron ingot]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
